items.text: ETR Sunday injuries: IN Dobbins/Harvey/Nabers/Etienne/Darnold/Price etc; Q Bowers/Flowers/Evans/DJ Moore/Warren/Pittman; Doubtful Nacua; OUT Daniels/Collins/Dowdle/Brooks/Pierce/Njoku/Coleman etc. Projecting Warren/Evans/Bowers in.
items.implication: Key status clarity for slate; beneficiaries clear for OUTs
items.opportunity: Warren lead; Schultz/others for Collins; Hubbard for Brooks

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday’s game; Marcus Mariota starts.
items.implication: Mariota under center; lower team total
items.opportunity: Reduced upside for WAS pass-catchers in tough matchup

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins for Sunday’s game at Indianapolis due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in Houston passing game
items.opportunity: High target share available for remaining pass-catchers

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle for Sunday vs Bengals due to toe injury; Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder).
Puka Nacua listed doubtful, will not practice; Sean McVay believes barring setback he could return next week vs Eagles. Davante Adams can carry load.
items.implication: Adams primary WR1 role this week
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for Adams and other LAR pass-catchers

items.text: ETR projections live for Week 3; Jahmyr Gibbs set new record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes).
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry ceiling in DET offense

items.text: Broncos RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams; Jonah Coleman ruled out (ankle).
items.implication: Full backfield available; Coleman out removes temporary lead
items.opportunity: Dobbins/Harvey split or lead roles intact

items.text: With Dowdle out, Steelers RB coach says Jaylen Warren will lead the group and get breather only when needed. Vertical pass not working for Rodgers; expect checkdown spam to Warren. Homer and Heidenreich as backups. Projecting Warren in despite Q (shoulder).
items.why: Coach comments + Dowdle OUT; checkdown opportunity
items.opportunity: Lead carries, snaps, checkdowns, third-down work

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected on IR (only 5 games across 3 seasons); pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.

Loves Chris Olave vs LV (10+ tgts, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high ypr to WRs); Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share w/ Collins out; IND 4th-most TE yds); Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, 38% RZ tgts).
items.why: Target/air yards/util + matchups; Schultz boosted by Collins OUT
items.opportunity: Olave air yards; Schultz volume; Watson RZ

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% routes this season, 6 targets (8% share) through games. Targets/route: 33% without London on field, 17% with him. Long-time fade continues despite past outlier.
items.why: Low route % and target share when London active
items.opportunity: London high target share; Pitts limited

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak rush D + high prop

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.

Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs); Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps); Terry McLaurin vs SEA (SEA fewest FP to WRs; low WAS total w/ Daniels out).
items.opportunity: Henderson could benefit in NE split; limited for others
